notes_for_editor: Build year, builder and height come only from the storymap item data, which is the record's own source; no second source was found, so the 1935 and 80 ft figures are unverified. Mapcarta and Pastmaps confirm the name and location only. The Game Commission map legend shows an unlabelled Tower Site symbol; it may or may not be this tower, so it was not used. Neither the NHLR Pennsylvania list nor the FFLOS Pennsylvania index includes Plumer (the NHLR list was re-read on 2026-10-09: 35 entries, no Plumer). The Game Commission map header spells the county VENANGO; the story uses Venango. Access level is omitted because no source gives a rule for the tower. The record's 24.4 m matches the storymap's 80 ft. Facebook and anyplaceamerica pages were not read (403 or unreadable). Verification 2026-10-09: the storymap Plumer Tower entry was re-read in context (1935, McClintock-Marshall, 80 ft); the story now says the tower is in the county and game land, with present-tense standing only as an inference from the storymap.
